system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Customize the chatAgent instructions with your own tone, greeting, etc.
system_prompt_style.note: Only README evidence; agent instructions appear to be fixed strings per agent config. A handoff swaps instructions via session.update.

env_context_strategy.note: Voice customer-service demo; there is no repository/environment context. Tool results may supply RAG context only if the user defines it.

observation_format.evidence_quote: which will run your specific tool logic and return an object to the conversation
observation_format.note: Tool results are objects returned into the conversation. Audio I/O is the user modality, not a tool-observation modality.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Handoffs are decided by the model and coordinated via tool calls

tool_count.note: chatSupervisor has a supervisor-delegation tool plus supervisor tools; the count is not visible in the evidence.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Each agentConfig can define instructions, tools, and toolLogic.
edit_primitive.note: No file-editing tools; this is a voice demo.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Each agentConfig can define instructions, tools, and toolLogic.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The event log is on the right, showing both client and server events.
loop_primitives.note: Supervisor calls tools and then responds. The Realtime session is driven by server events.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Prompting models to follow a state machine
planning_granularity.note: The state machine is prompt-only; this refers to the customerServiceRetail scenario.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: a more intelligent, text-based supervisor model (e.g., `gpt-4.1`) is used extensively for tool calls and more complex responses
multi_agent_topology.note: The default chatSupervisor chat agent delegates to a supervisor model; the fit to orchestrator_workers is loose. A sequential-handoff scenario (pipeline/peer-like) is selectable.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: A handoff triggers a session.update event with new instructions and tools.
delegation_mechanism.note: Default chatSupervisor forwards context to the supervisor model call (closer to subagent_spawn). Handoff scenarios use role_handoff.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: a placeholder human agent for escalations
human_in_loop.note: The user converses by voice, but there is no approval gating; the simulated human is an agent.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: The conversation transcript is on the left, including tool calls, tool call responses, and agent changes.

self_verification.evidence_quote: agent to `o4-mini` to validate and initiate a return, as an example high-stakes decision
self_verification.note: Escalation to o4-mini to validate a return in customerServiceRetail config; also output guardrail check on assistant messages. Default chatSupervisor uses a supervisor model; coded from README prose.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: To reduce cost, try using `gpt-4o-mini-realtime` for the chatAgent and/or `gpt-4.1-mini` for the supervisor model.
cost_controls.note: Task split between a cheap realtime model and a supervisor, chosen by task difficulty.

execution_isolation.note: Tools are JS functions in the Next.js client or server; there are no shell actions.

permission_model.evidence_quote: You can modify the decision boundary by adding new items to the `# Allow List of Permitted Actions` section.
permission_model.note: This allowlist is prompt-level; it decides what the chat agent handles versus defers. It is not enforced authorisation.

tracing.evidence_quote: The event log is on the right, showing both client and server events. Click to see the full payload.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: The spirit of this repo is to demonstrate the core logic for new agentic flows
eval_hooks.note: No eval files appear in the file tree.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Assistant messages are checked for safety and compliance before they are shown in the UI.

target_domain.evidence_quote: This is a demonstration of more advanced patterns for voice agents, using the OpenAI Realtime API and the OpenAI Agents SDK.

open_source.note: A LICENSE file exists, but its type is not shown.
